TYPES.HINTS.Actor.character: A player character with six Statistics, an Action Dice pool, a Gateway, Feats, Weapons and Armour.
TYPES.HINTS.Item.gateway: A calling, profession or culture. Contributes an HP bonus, a Save profile and an always-on benefit.
TYPES.HINTS.Item.feat: A trained capability. May grant a Specialization Die (one d6) when its trigger applies.
TYPES.HINTS.Item.weapon: A weapon with a damage die, a precision die, reach and the Statistics it uses.
TYPES.HINTS.Item.armour: Body armour or a shield. While equipped, adds its AC bonus; body armour's category gates the AC feats.

KD20.Settings.showTargetAc.hint: When on, attack cards show players the targeted token's AC and the margin. When off, players see only the outcome tier; the GM always sees everything.
